column3: “the families” renders “the clans” (also in verses 4 and 11).
“are right in their statements” renders “speak right”; “You shall surely give” renders an emphatic doubled verb, and “transfer” renders “make pass over” (also in verse 8).
“a statutory ordinance” renders “a statute of judgment.”
“My command” renders “my mouth”; NASB puts the note on Meribah in parentheses, and “Meribah of Kadesh” renders “Meribath-kadesh.”
“the Spirit” renders “a spirit (ruach),” without the article.
“your authority” renders “your majesty (hod),” and “obey him” renders “hear.”
